method: Same recovered project, source-only renderer bundle and HyperFrames 0.8.181; no AI clip regeneration. Host timestamps of streamed phase events.

costAccounting.note: Immediate GPU shutdown reading was 1.41 credits; subsequent balance settlement increased the observed charge to 2.15. Account deltas are account-wide.

limitations: Single indicative measurement, not a repeated controlled hardware benchmark
Local startup initially failed because extracted Node lacked executable permissions; repaired local run started later and overlapped only part of the CPU run
Local Node archive was cached on retry; npm workspaces, browser and HyperFrames installation were fresh
Short validation tests and smaller-copy transcoding also ran on the local host during the local measurement
Different CPU counts and renderer concurrency: four locally versus two on Colab
Remote large-project upload used chunked transfer in the benchmark adapter
Local electricity and host rental costs are not included
